# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/chrisbenincasa/tunarr/security/advisories/new). Don't open a public issue.

Include:

- The Tunarr version and how it's installed (Docker, binary, other)
- Steps that reproduce the problem against a real Tunarr build
- What an attacker can do with it, and what access they need first

## AI and scanner output

You may use AI tools or scanners to find problems. Before you report one, confirm it yourself against a running Tunarr build. Reports of unconfirmed AI or scanner output will be closed without a detailed response.

## Supported versions

Only the latest stable release receives security fixes.
